text: In April 2026 Shenzhen-listed Qingdao Doublestar completed the consolidation of South Korean tyre maker Kumho Tire: it now indirectly owns 45% of Kumho Tire, which became a controlled subsidiary of the Chinese company.
short: Qingdao Doublestar controls Kumho Tire with 45%.

source.name: Tyrepress: Share listing completes Doublestar's Kumho Tire consolidation
source.quote: Qingdao Doublestar has formally completed its long-running transaction to consolidate control of South Korean tyre manufacturer Kumho Tire
source.note: The article's picture caption adds: 'Doublestar now indirectly owns 45% of equity in Kumho Tire.'
